hook: Stop feeding your dog the turkey skin. Here's what to share instead.
skin: Very fatty. It can upset a dog's tummy.
gravy: Gravy and stuffing often have onion and garlic. Toxic to dogs!
turkey: Plain turkey, no skin or bones.
vet: Ate something it shouldn't? Call your vet right away.
game: In Doodle Doggo, you can't cook or feed anything toxic.
